## a copy hands an editing agent the requirement text

ID: `portable-template/a-copy-hands-an-editing-agent-the-requirement-text`

Status: **implemented and tested**

A repository made from the template SHALL include `.claude/settings.json` and `.codex/hooks.json` whose PreToolUse hooks run `uv run lockstep-hook` (the copy's own locked Lockstep) on file edits and shell commands, without `PCW_MODE=block`, and SHALL git-ignore `docs/links.json`. Its first decision record SHALL carry a `- Governs:` line naming a file the copy has.

## a copy runs its commit checks after a move and in every worktree

ID: `portable-template/a-copy-runs-its-commit-checks-after-a-move-and-in-every-worktree`

Status: **implemented and tested**

A repository made from the template SHALL hold tracked, executable `.githooks/pre-commit` and `.githooks/pre-push` scripts that each run `lefthook run` for their hook and name no machine path, and the copier tasks SHALL set the local `core.hooksPath` to the relative path `.githooks`, so a commit in a moved copy or in any worktree runs the `lefthook.yml` jobs.

Implemented by:

- `copier.yml` — [`copier.yml:34`](../../copier.yml#L34)

## a fresh copy generates and checks its wiki

ID: `portable-template/a-fresh-copy-generates-and-checks-its-wiki`

Status: **implemented and tested**

A repository made with `copier copy` SHALL set `generated_wiki: true` in its `lockstep.yaml`, hold committed `generated/wiki/` pages written by its `lockstep check project`, and run `lockstep check project --check`, `python -m lockstep.wiki_reach` and `lockstep check docmeta` in its `make check`. Its `AGENTS.md` SHALL tell the agent to read `generated/wiki/index.md` first, and its `docs/index.md` SHALL name that index.

Implemented by:

- `copier.yml` — [`copier.yml:11`](../../copier.yml#L11)

- Scenario `a-fresh-copy-has-the-wiki-and-checks-it`: tested by `tests/test_template_portable.py::test_a_fresh_copy_has_the_wiki_and_checks_it` ([`tests/test_template_portable.py:307`](../../tests/test_template_portable.py#L307))

## a fresh copy ships its planned file layout

ID: `portable-template/a-fresh-copy-ships-its-planned-file-layout`

Status: **implemented and tested**

A repository made with `copier copy` SHALL include `lockstep.yaml` with `governed:` and `fixed:` covering `src/<package>/` and a `layout:` row for each starter source file (`__init__.py`, `core.py`, `cli.py`), each with a purpose, the requirements it implements, its tests and its typed exports. Each starter file SHALL hold a cog block in its docstring that the copy's `lockstep check project` fills with the row's plan text, so the edit hook refuses a file under `src/<package>/` that has no row. Its `AGENTS.md` SHALL say that a plan adds a row for every new or changed file with the OpenSpec change and that `uv run lockstep layout` then creates the files, and its `make check` SHALL run the whole-tree check (`lockstep check --repo . --base <ref>`) against the merge base with `origin/main`, else the first commit, saying it skipped when there is no commit yet.

Implemented by:

- `template/lockstep.yaml.jinja` — [`template/lockstep.yaml.jinja:1`](../../template/lockstep.yaml.jinja#L1)

- Scenario `a-fresh-copy-refuses-an-unplanned-source-file`: tested by `tests/test_template_portable.py::test_a_fresh_copy_refuses_an_unplanned_source_file` ([`tests/test_template_portable.py:169`](../../tests/test_template_portable.py#L169))
- Scenario `a-default-copy-with-no-remote-passes-make-check`: tested by `tests/test_template_portable.py::test_a_default_copy_with_no_remote_passes_make_check` ([`tests/test_template_portable.py:257`](../../tests/test_template_portable.py#L257))

## a repository made with the defaults works for anyone

ID: `portable-template/a-repository-made-with-the-defaults-works-for-anyone`

Status: **implemented and tested**

A repository made with `copier copy --defaults` SHALL have a `lefthook.yml` with no `remotes:` block, whose pre-commit jobs refuse a staged `.env` file and run `gitleaks` on the staged changes; an `AGENTS.md`, `pyproject.toml` and `lefthook.yml` that name no home-folder path (`~/`), SSH alias, person or e-mail address of the template's owner, other than the public URL Lockstep installs from; no `authors` line when `author` is empty; no local git `user.name` or `user.email` unless `git_user_name` and `git_user_email` were answered; and `.copier-answers.yml` with `code2_workspace: false`, `ship_planning_gate: false` and `ship_one_page_plans: false`. Its `make check` SHALL exit 0.

Implemented by:

- `template/lefthook.yml.jinja` — [`template/lefthook.yml.jinja:1`](../../template/lefthook.yml.jinja#L1)

- Scenario `default-copy-has-no-machine-bound-parts`: tested by `tests/test_template_portable.py::test_default_copy_has_no_machine_bound_parts` ([`tests/test_template_portable.py:51`](../../tests/test_template_portable.py#L51))

## the commit check stages rewritten files that git tracks

ID: `portable-template/the-commit-check-stages-rewritten-files-that-git-tracks`

Status: **implemented and tested**

The `lockstep-fast` pre-commit job of a copy SHALL stage each file `lockstep check project` reports as rewritten, except a file git ignores, and SHALL then run `make fast`. An ignored rewritten file SHALL NOT make the commit fail.

- `template/lefthook.yml.jinja` — [`template/lefthook.yml.jinja:1`](../../template/lefthook.yml.jinja#L1)

## updating an older copy adds no layout plan

ID: `portable-template/updating-an-older-copy-adds-no-layout-plan`

Status: **implemented and tested**

`copier update` of a copy made before the template shipped `lockstep.yaml` SHALL NOT add `lockstep.yaml` and SHALL leave the copy's starter source files under `src/<package>/` unchanged, while adding or updating the template's other files.

Implemented by:

- `copier.yml` — [`copier.yml:13`](../../copier.yml#L13)
